title: Installable releases that keep the SSH key across updates

review.text: Both findings from round 2 are fixed. A release build with an empty HERDR_KEY_PASSWORD, which is what GitHub passes when that secret is never created, is now signed with the fixed key. With every secret empty it still falls back to the debug key. The apk-* cleanup step now runs only when a keystore is present, so with no secrets the old pre-releases are kept, and the README says so.
checks: Built ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease with a throwaway test keystore, HERDR_KEY_PASSWORD set to an empty string and GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER=42. The build succeeded, apksigner shows the signer CN=reviewtest and aapt shows versionCode 42 (F1 fixed).
Built with every HERDR_* variable empty. The build succeeded and the APK is signed with the Android Debug certificate (fallback still works).
Built with a wrong HERDR_KEY_PASSWORD. packageRelease fails with a key read error, so a misconfigured key never quietly ships a debug-signed APK.

Read and parsed .github/workflows/android.yml. 'Remove old branch pre-releases' now needs PUBLISH == 'true' && env.HERDR_KEYSTORE_FILE != ''. That variable is written to GITHUB_ENV only when HERDR_KEYSTORE_BASE64 is set, and a failed publish step skips the cleanup by default (F2 fixed). README secrets table and install note updated to match.
limitations: The workflow was not run on GitHub Actions. The publish and cleanup branches were checked by reading the step conditions, not by a live run on the default branch.
Did not repeat the on-device checks of the identity export/import from earlier rounds. This commit touches only the build script, the workflow and the README.

title: Replace the app icon with the herdr icon

review.text: The change does what the task asked: the adaptive icon is the official herdr logo (the embedded path is byte-identical to assets/logo.svg in herdrdev/herdr, the same artwork herdr.dev serves), with a foreground, a #d9dad8 background and a monochrome layer; the old stacked-panes artwork and its green colour are gone; and the CI-built APK from this HEAD carries that icon. Merging the base branch did not touch any icon resource, and both CI runs (core tests + APK build) pass on 46315bc. I could not exercise the icon on a live launcher (no device or emulator on this machine), so mask and themed-icon behaviour were checked by rendering the vector and by inspecting the built APK's resources.
checks: git diff --stat dcb947e...HEAD: exactly 4 files, +25/-12, matching the agent's description; working tree clean at 46315bc.

Extracted the large android:pathData from app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml and compared it to the <path d> in the official logo.svg fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com/herdrdev/herdr/master/assets/logo.svg: byte-identical (1849 chars); herdr.dev/assets/logo.png and the repo's logo.png are byte-identical (sha256 56fc2db8...).
aapt2 (8.7.3, local Gradle cache) compile --dir app/src/main/res: exit 0, produced drawable_ic_launcher_foreground.xml.flat, mipmap-anydpi-v26_ic_launcher.xml.flat and values_colors.arsc.flat.

Downloaded the CI pre-release APK herdr-android-15.apk (sha256 e74ccb11..., target 46315bc) and dumped it with aapt2: adaptive-icon has background=color/ic_launcher_background (#ffd9dad8), foreground=drawable/ic_launcher_foreground, monochrome=drawable/ic_launcher_foreground; manifest application icon = res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml.

Reconstructed the foreground vector geometry and rendered it over the #d9dad8 background with rsvg-convert; the central 72dp region matches the official logo's bounding box exactly (104,139,512,512) and differs from the official logo render by only edge anti-aliasing (73 pixels, max 68).

Rendered the icon under circle, squircle (n=4), rounded-square and square masks plus a themed/monochrome variant; the sheep and its prompt read correctly, and the body reaches the mask edge everywhere it would otherwise be cut (see icon-masks.png).

git grep for the removed identifiers: ic_background has no hits, and the old artwork colours (7DD3B6, EF7B70, E2B64A, 0F5141) have no hits in XML resources; no mipmap PNGs or other icon resources remain, only ic_launcher_foreground.xml and mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml.

limitations: No Android emulator or attached device on this machine and no local Android SDK/JDK, so the icon and its themed variant were never seen on a running launcher; the APK was produced by CI, and mask/themed appearance was checked by rendering the vector geometry rather than by Android's own compositor.

Android's runtime PathParser/VectorDrawable rasterisation of the (non-zero fill) path was not executed here; the source is byte-identical to the official SVG, aapt2 compiled it, and the CI-built APK contains it, but I did not screenshot an on-device result.

The GPG key 2745AB0A4F25DA35 is still absent here, so any future board merge that signs its merge commit (including merging this task into the base branch) will fail the same way the sync did; the agent's 46315bc merge itself is unsigned.

title: Audit phone UI and UX of the app
msg: Review: Pass · 1 minor, 1 trivial. I've finished the phone UI/UX audit and published the report: **https://claude.ai/artifact/demoReport0000000000001**

findings.subject: The report cites the IdentityStore key-regeneration bug at a line range the file does not have
findings.where: index.html, 'Also noticed', item 1 (the same text is repeated in the task's closing note)
findings.proof: The report writes 'app/…/data/IdentityStore.kt:313-314'. app/src/main/kotlin/com/makefunstuff/herdr/data/IdentityStore.kt is 105 lines (wc -l), and the behaviour it describes — a failed identity.bin decrypt silently generating and writing a new key — is at lines 43-44: `(if (file.exists()) runCatching { read() }.getOrNull() else null) ?: KeyGen.ed25519(comment()).also { write(it) }`. A scan of all 31 distinct '*.kt:NNN' citations in the report found this to be the only one out of range (review/citation-scan.txt). The claim itself is true; only the line pointer is wrong, so a reader who follows

findings.subject: The report calls the audited commit 'main', which is not a branch in this repository
findings.where: index.html, opening paragraph: 'Audited at commit dcb947e (main, with the native Coordinator chat from AND-1)'
findings.proof: `git branch -a | grep -i main` is empty. origin/HEAD is refs/heads/claude/project-thread-avm1v2, and `git branch -a --contains dcb947e` lists claude/project-thread-avm1v2, work/2-replace-agent-terminals-with-n, work/5-installable-releases-that-keep and the local work/3-audit-phone-ui-and-ux-of-the-a — no main. The commit hash is also printed, so nothing is ambiguous; this is a naming slip only (review/repo-clean.txt).

review.text: Yes. The audit does what the task asked, all of it and working. The report exists (292,169 bytes, sha256 662e0933…), renders at the board link (HTTP 200) and is a real, self-contained HTML file with 12 embedded screenshots. It walks every screen and flow the task names — first setup (key, adding a machine, jump hosts, import), the Agents list, an agent's screen, Machines and a machine's screen (workspaces, tabs, panes, starting an agent), the terminal, and Settings — plus navigation/back and dark/light. It ranks 15 issues by daily-use impact, each with a concrete fix, keeps a separate 'Around the native chats' section that says what the rest of the app needs around AND-1/AND-2 instead of repeating them, and closes with a prioritised P1–P3 follow-up list. The audit is not just prose: the agent's transcript shows it built the debug APK from a scratch copy (git archive HEAD, ./gradlew assembleDebug), created an Android 15 pixel_7 AVD, installed and drove the app against a private sshd and a separate herdr session with one blocked and one done Claude agent, took 34 screenshots, dropped and restored the connection, and ran 360 dp at 1.3× font and light/dark; the scratch folder and screenshots are still on disk and their on-screen text (OCR) matches the report. The repository is untouched: clean working tree at dcb947e, HEAD is exactly the branch base, no commit added, nothing pushed, no stash. Cleanup also holds: no 'and3audit' session, no listener on tcp/2223, the audit emulator gone. I re-checked the report's factual claims against the code and live herdr; they hold, including the trickier ones (15 s SSH keep-alive, 20 s awaitApi, the 1/2/4/8/16/32 backoff with no ticking countdown, 7 hard-coded kinds vs herdr's 24, PATH-before-~/.local/bin herdr search order, the double popBackStack, the Coordinator card text). Two inaccuracies were found and are listed below; neither changes a conclusion. Severity used here: critical = the deliverable is missing/false or the repo was mutated; major = a false claim that changes a conclusion; minor = a real inaccuracy that does not change a conclusion; trivial = cosmetic/naming.
checks: Repository untouched (critical check): `git status --porcelain` empty; HEAD = dcb947e1cf6f6091d52d274b2a77b01972ec98c1 = 'Native Coordinator chat when herdr-projects is installed (#2)'; `git diff --stat origin/claude/project-thread-avm1v2...HEAD` empty; no stash; reflog shows only 'reset: moving to HEAD'; no commit added by this task and nothing pushed. No added/changed/deleted files attributable to the audit.

Report exists and serves: /home/dev/.herdr-projects/reports/herdr-android/3/index.html, 292,169 bytes; board link https://devbox.tail1234.ts.net:8750/herdr-android/3/report/index.html -> HTTP 200; the agent's artifact link https://claude.ai/artifact/demoReport0000000000001 -> HTTP 200.

Report structure covers the task: 12 embedded screenshots; header names commit dcb947e; 'How this was checked' table; 'Around the native chats (AND-1, AND-2)' section; 15 ranked issues each with a fix; 'Follow-up work, in order' P1-P3; 'Also noticed' list. Screens named by the task (setup/key/test/save, Agents list, agent screen, machines + machine screen, terminal, Settings) are all present.

Systematic citation check: extracted every '*.kt:NNN' citation from the report and compared each with wc -l. Of 31 distinct citations exactly one (IdentityStore.kt:313-314) exceeds the file length; all others are in range (review/citation-scan.txt).

Issue-by-issue code re-check at dcb947e: issue 1 (manifest has only INTERNET+ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE; no notification channel/FGS/POST_NOTIFICATIONS anywhere; HerdrApp.kt:29-30 calls setForeground; HostManager.kt:55-61 stops sessions) holds. Issue 2/3 (HostSession.kt:123 awaitApi default 20_000 ms; HostSession.kt:182 backoff min(120, 1 shl attempt); Common.kt:69 static 'Reconnecting in Ns'; AgentsScreen.kt:75,79 'Not connected yet / Check the Machines tab'; MachinesScreen.kt:134 'Showing the last known state') holds. Issue 4 (Machine.kt:59-66 SEARCH tries $(command -v herdr) before $HOME/.local/bin/herdr) holds; a plain sshd PATH resolves to the 0.8.2 binary while the server is 0.9.5. Issue 5 (NewSheet.kt:68-70 Column has no imePadding/verticalScroll; CoordinatorScreen.kt:181 imePadding under Scaffold padding) holds. Issue 6 (PromptGuess returns last line ending '?' else last line) holds. Issue 8 (NewSheet.kt:34 KINDS = 7 entries; herdr agent start --help lists 24) holds. Issue 11 (enableEdgeToEdge only at MainActivity.kt:47; manifest configChanges includes uiMode; Theme.kt:52-55 fixed Light/Dark) holds. Issue 12 (EditMachineScreen.kt two consecutive popBackStack) holds. Issue 15 (TerminalScreen.kt heightIn(min=36.dp); StatusDot has no contentDescription) holds. Evidence: review/grounding-checks.txt.

Live herdr on this host: /usr/bin/herdr = 0.8.2 (and /usr/sbin/herdr is a hardlink to it) while ~/.local/bin/herdr = 0.9.5, exactly the split issue 4 describes; `herdr session list` includes the stopped 'pi-android-claude' named in issue 7; `herdr agent start --help` lists 24 kinds (issue 8). Evidence: review/herdr-versions.txt.

The device run is real and reproducible from the audit's own transcript: git archive HEAD -> scratch, ./gradlew assembleDebug, avdmanager create avd -k system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64 -d pixel_7, emulator -avd phone -port 5560, adb install -r app-debug.apk, ui.sh tap/shot sequence (34 PNGs still on disk), a private sshd on 127.0.0.1:2223, `kill` of sshd to drop the connection, wm size 720x1440 + density 320 + font_scale 1.3. OCR of the report's screenshots matches its quotes ('Not connected yet', 'Reconnecting in 16s', raw ECONNREFUSED, 'herdr 0.9.5', the squeezed 'pi-android-claude (stopped)' chip, 'herdr: lost connection to server', the Coordinator keyboard gap, dark Settings). Evidence: review/emulator-run.txt.
Cleanup claim verified: no herdr session 'and3audit' (sessions now default/chattest/pi-android-claude), no listener on tcp/2223, and the audit's emulator on port 5560 is gone.
limitations: I did not run the app myself. The report's device-only numbers (pane grid 62x49 / 62x28 on takeover, cold-start and resume timings, the dark-mode status-bar switch) were not re-measured; they are checked against the audit's screenshots/transcript and the code, not independently reproduced.

Live counts are time-dependent: this host now has sessions default/chattest/pi-android-claude and `herdr machine list` is empty, so the import flow ('Import herdr machines from here') could not produce candidates for anyone on this host. The report's treatment of import is thin — one passing mention in issue 4 plus the coverage-table cell 'Jump hosts, import (no second machine)' — and its stated reason is not the real precondition (import needs saved machines on the connected host, not a second machine), but with an empty `herdr machine list` there was nothing to exercise, so I did not raise it as a finding.

The report's 'Also noticed' list repeats two issues (the herdr search order and the double popBackStack) that are already ranked issues 4 and 12; that is redundancy, not an error, so it is not a finding.

title: Replace agent terminals with native chat views

findings.subject: MachineTest.commandFindsHerdrAndQuotesArguments fails on this machine because /usr/bin/herdr exists (it expects exit 127 and gets 2).
findings.proof: ./gradlew -p core test --rerun-tasks on 5ac73e5: 44 tests completed, 1 failed (this test), 1 skipped. An earlier review round showed that the base commit fails the same way.

review.text: Yes. The chat feature reviewed in earlier rounds is unchanged, and the new commit fixes the leak that ran out SSH sessions. Leaving a chat now closes its SSH channel and stops the remote tail -F. I confirmed this with a regression test that fails on the old code and with 14 real open/close cycles on the emulator. The only failing core test is the known MachineTest, which fails on this machine because /usr/bin/herdr is installed; that problem predates this change.
checks: ./gradlew -p core test --rerun-tasks on 5ac73e5 with JDK 17: 44 tests, 42 passed, 1 skipped (LiveChatTest, no live environment) and 1 failed (the pre-existing MachineTest). TranscriptFollowerCancelTest, TranscriptFollowerTest, TranscriptTest, BlockedPromptTest and MarkdownTest all pass.

Mutation check: I reverted the TranscriptFollower cleanup to the old plain withContext(Dispatchers.IO) and ran TranscriptFollowerCancelTest. It fails with 'cancelling must close the channel', so the test does catch the bug. I restored the source afterwards with git checkout.

On emulator-5580 with the debug app connected to this machine, I opened claude·tclaude from the Agents list and pressed Back 14 times. Every cycle had exactly 1 remote 'tail -c 2000000 -F' while the chat was open and 0 after it closed, and the number of sshd-session processes stayed at 8 throughout. The 15th open loaded the conversation (prompts, compact Run tool rows, markdown replies, Idle state, message box).

Read the 5ac73e5 diff. Both TranscriptFollower.follow and ApiClient.call now close their channel under NonCancellable + Dispatchers.IO in finally. The close runs before coroutineScope waits for the pump child, so the blocking readLine is unblocked and the scope can finish.
limitations: The APK on the emulator was installed at 14:13:39, before the commit at 14:15:44. I did not rebuild it, so the device check assumes it was built from the same source that was then committed. The unit test and mutation check do run against the committed code.
I re-checked only the feature areas this commit touches. The chat UI, blocked-prompt cards and codex/pi transcripts were verified in earlier review rounds and were not exercised again here.
LiveChatTest was not run because no HERDR_LIVE_* environment is set.

title: Native Coordinator chat when herdr-projects is installed

review.text: The earlier major finding F1 is fixed: BoardCommands.remote now runs the board launcher through a login shell ("sh -c 'exec \"$SHELL\" -lc \"$1\"'"), and a unit test plus a stand-in launcher reproduce the login-PATH bug and its fix. Nothing critical is new or left unfixed, and the rest of the Coordinator chat still satisfies the task. One verification claim in the closing note does not reproduce on this host (with bare /usr/bin:/bin the old way already reads 'idle' because /usr/bin/herdr exists here), but the fix is still proven by the new unit test.
checks: Ran the full core suite at 140940f: 29 tests, 1 failure, the known preexisting environmental MachineTest.commandFindsHerdrAndQuotesArguments (this host has /usr/bin/herdr, so the test's bare-PATH 127 expectation is wrong here). BoardTest is 8/8, including the new runsTheLauncherInALoginShellWithItsPath.

Ran LiveBoardTest with HERDR_BOARD_LIVE=1: the app's exact locate/list command reaches /home/dev/.herdr-projects/data/bin/herdr-projects and reports host devbox, version 1.0.1, Coordinator state idle, 12 messages; a refused `do` returns the expected error so nothing was sent.

Reproduced F1 and its fix with a stand-in launcher that calls `herdr` by bare name: with an empty bare PATH the OLD direct exec gives HERDR-NOT-FOUND (exit 127), while the NEW login-shell wrapper sources the profile and gives HERDR-FOUND (exit 0).

Checked the unit test is meaningful: before the fix remote() returned the bare command, so the launcher would have seen only /usr/bin:/bin and the PATH assertion would fail; after the fix it sees the profile's PATH.

Read herdr-projects crates/flow/src/remote.rs, coordinator/far.rs and board/update/actions.rs: the app's `remote dispatch` {text,delegate} reaches coordinator::requests::send, the same entry the board's box uses, and the list fields (state/error/queue/readable/said/sent/talk) match coordinator/far.rs.

Confirmed the agent's bare-/usr/bin:/bin claim does not reproduce here: both the old direct exec and the new login-shell command read state=idle with 12 messages, because /usr/bin/herdr is on that PATH on this machine.
